title: Canopus Manifest
description: Schema for a Canopus TLM topology manifest file (v0.1).

name.description: Unique machine-readable topology name. Letters, digits, underscores; must start with a letter.

description.description: Optional human-readable narrative describing the topology.

tags.description: Optional tags for filtering and grouping topologies.

components.description: Hierarchical tree of UVM components. Containment is expressed through nesting; IDs must be globally unique across the entire manifest.

connections.description: Flat list of directed connections between components. All from/to values must reference IDs declared in components.

id.description: Globally unique component identifier. Used as the reference target in connection from/to fields. Letters, digits, underscores; must start with a letter.

type.description: UVM component type from the Canopus taxonomy.

label.description: Optional display name or SystemVerilog class name shown in the visualisation.

mode.description: Agent operating mode. Only meaningful on uvm_agent components; ignored on all others. Defaults to active if omitted.

level.description: Abstraction level for depth-based filtering. 0 = top-level test; higher integers = deeper in the hierarchy.

meta.description: Free-form key-value metadata for display and tooling. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans, or arrays of strings.

children.description: Nested child components. Presence of this field makes the component a compound (container) node in the visualisation.

from.description: ID of the source component. Must reference an ID declared in the components tree.

from_port.description: Optional named port on the source component. Used when a component has multiple ports of the same type (e.g. a monitor with several analysis ports).

to.description: ID of the target component. Must reference an ID declared in the components tree.

to_port.description: Optional named port on the target component.

type.description: Connection type from the Canopus taxonomy. Drives port-side assignment, edge colour, and dash pattern in the visualisation.

transaction.description: Optional transaction type name (e.g. apb_seq_item). Shown as an edge label when annotation is enabled.

label.description: Optional display label override. Shown instead of transaction when both are present.

meta.description: Free-form key-value metadata. Use boundary_cross: true to mark edges that cross compound-node boundaries for distinct visual rendering.

boundary_cross.description: Set to true for analysis edges that cross sub-environment boundaries. Triggers dashed edge rendering.

connectionType.title: Connection Type
connectionType.description: Canopus connection type taxonomy. Namespaced into tlm (TLM port connections), ref (object references), and reg (register model connections).
